tr.gth: ส่วนบนสุดของร่างกายของคนหรือสัตว์; ผม (ในบางบริบท)
der: หัวหอม / หัวมัน
หัว classifies bulbs and tubers — heads underground
หัวรั้น / หัวอ่อน
'hard-headed / soft-headed' — temperament lives in the head here, not the heart
'head of the dark' — time has a head and a tail

rule: หัว divides six ways and the biggest group is not the body. FRONT-OR-BEGINNING (9) takes the leader, the heading, the price on a head and the provincial towns — anything at the front of something. THE HEAD ITSELF (1) takes body parts named for it and acts done to it. THE MIND (3) takes cast of thought: หัวร้อน, หัวโบราณ, หัวสูง. A PERSON OF A BENT (4) takes roles: the cook, the banker, the canvasser. TOPMOST (11) and PROTRUDING (12) split the architectural and instrument senses. ESSENCE (16) takes หัวกะทิ, the first press, and หัวใจ, the organ that is the point of the body. ชวนหัว and เล่นหัว belong to sense 17, which is หัวเราะ 'to laugh' — a separate lexeme that merely begins with หัว, and they go there rather than anywhere in the head family.

notes.text:
Rule: FRONT-OR-BEGINNING (9) is the biggest group, not the body — the leader, the
heading, the price on a head, the provincial towns. THE HEAD (1) takes body parts
named for it and acts done to it. THE MIND (3) takes cast of thought. A PERSON OF A

**ชวนหัว and เล่นหัว went to sense 17**, which is หัวเราะ 'to laugh' — a separate

notes.text:
Unsure: หัวหน่าว / หัวเหน่า (the pubis) filed under 12, protruding, rather than 1.
It is a body part but not a part of the head, and the naming is the protrusion.
